scientific_integrity: The displayed rational form is derived from exact preimage decomposition and independently checked in finite cases; finite scripts are not an infinite proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: One pass, the ordered ternary alphabet and uniform all-input sampling; no claim about Shannon entropy, larger alphabets or iterates. Earlier results establish the map and some output-support or binary properties. Prior equivalence under another terminology remains possible.
title: The second-moment law for ternary tortoise sorting
